title: Israel’s top court says government is not giving Palestinian prisoners enough food
summary: Justices rule state is legally obliged to ensure ‘basic level of existence’ and orders authorities to improve nutrition Israel’s supreme court has ruled that the government has failed to provide Palestinian security prisoners with adequate food for basic subsistence and ordered authorities to improve their nutrition. Sunday’s decision was a rare case in which the country’s highest court ruled against the government’s conduct during the nearly two-year war. Continue reading...
